title: Hunts FH-020T: Wire the staff scan screen and held-claim review screen to the door route and review actions

source.ref: Split from FH-020S (2026-11-10): the nonce table, door route, review, override and appeal shipped dark; the screens that call them are separate.

detail: Mount components/hunts/staff-proof-screens.tsx at app/(main)/hunts/staff, post a scanned or typed code to /api/hunts/staff/verify, list held claims (hunt_claims.state = needs_review) for the reviewer's venue, and call lib/hunts/staff-review.ts reviewClaim through a server action behind decide('review_claim'). Show the player's appeal button on a rejected claim. Done when: the staff page renders signed in as venue staff with HUNTS_CLAIMS_ENABLED on and 404s otherwise. Requires: FH-020S. Owner role: Game systems.
